title: A Will for the Witness
author: Quentin Blackwood
blurb: Oscar Dunmore, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
